exposure: Surgical intervention for LGGs (pre-surgery, 1st day post-surgery, 1st week post-surgery, 1st month post-surgery)
cohort: The study included 19 patients with low-grade gliomas and 12 healthy controls from whom cord blood samples were collected.
finding: Controls showed significantly lower serum endocan levels compared to before and after surgery in low-grade glioma patients, with a trend of increased mean serum levels from before surgery to the first week post-surgery, which then became lower by the first month.
